# tern-sidepulse

A macOS Tern window plugin that shows your Oh My Pi (OMP) sessions in SidePulse: working, waiting, done, failed.

Canonical URL: https://alphastorm.github.io/tern-sidepulse/

- [README: requirements, install, commands, configuration, privacy, and limitations](https://github.com/alphastorm/tern-sidepulse/blob/main/README.md)
- [Compatibility and contract probe: exact exercised versions and untested cases](https://github.com/alphastorm/tern-sidepulse/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/alphastorm/tern-sidepulse/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi, Tern, or SidePulse maintainers.
